rationale: The Dutch administrative court decision (RBAMS) directly adjudicates an appeal against the refusal of a water permit (Watervergunning) governed by the regional waterboard ordinance (Keur Amstel, Gooi en Vecht). Under the coding protocol, an explicit Watervergunning/keur permit dispute is substantively WATER under both calibrated and strict labels and falls squarely within regulatory_permit, without involving household water/sanitation utility connection refusal or informal settlements.
